BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Munieipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the current RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House)
District symbols, and indications as shown on Map No. 3-K in the area bounded by:
       The alley next north of and parallel to West Potomac Avenue; a line 237.33 feet west of
       and parallel to the public alley next west of and parallel to North Pulaski Road; West
       Potomac Avenue; and a line 267.33 feet west of and parallel to the public alley next west
       of and parallel to North Pulaski Road

to those of an RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.
